name: Nagra Pakusadewo
bio: Nagra Kautsar Pakusadewo is an Indonesian actor. He is the son of actor Tio Pakusadewo.

credits.title: Red Before Dawn
credits.overview: Amidst the volatile dawn of Indonesian independence, five individuals from starkly contrasting socio-political backgrounds must navigate a heavily fractured nation to deliver a critical state document, confronting severe hostility and paranoia from the very revolutionary factions they seek to serve.

credits.title: The Sea Speaks His Name
credits.overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia's New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

credits.title: Siti Vampire
credits.overview: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

credits.title: Four Seasons in Java
credits.overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. There, she finds power in things that have been abandoned: discarded electronic devices that mysteriously light up and a community of outcasts living on the fringes of society. credits.title: Autopsy: Dead Body Can Talk
credits.overview: Dr. Sumy Hastry—a sharp, calm, and experienced forensic is intertwined with intuition and supernatural phenomena that are part of her long journey.

credits.title: Semua Akan Baik-Baik Saja
credits.overview: After their mother Mentari passes away, a group of estranged siblings must move in with their older brother Langit, forcing them to confront their personal struggles and heal old wounds to rediscover the true meaning of family.

credits.title: Taneuh Kalaknat
credits.overview: A group of horror YouTubers called The Eyes visit Tanah Kalaknat, a cursed place where it's said no one can leave. Despite numerous prohibitions, their curiosity leads them there. Upon arrival, strange things begin to happen, and one by one, The Eyes members begin to experience life-threatening misfortune.

credits.title: Dopamine
credits.overview: A young couple facing eviction and debt experiences an unexpected event that changes their lives.

credits.title: The Secret Recipe
credits.overview: When a gifted chef loses his sharp sense of taste, he turns to an old friend who helps him rediscover traditional flavors through an old recipe book.

credits.title: Perayaan Mati Rasa
credits.overview: When they suddenly lose their parents, rival siblings lan and Uta must set aside their dreams to help each other navigate their grief.

credits.title: Blood Debt
credits.overview: The old factory where Erwina works holds a dark secret - and because her family owes a debt to the devil, she must pay a terrible price for being there.

credits.title: Temurun
credits.overview: After their mother dies during a violent break-in, two siblings move in with their estranged father discover their family's sinister heritage.

credits.title: The Female Followers of the Devil: Part 2
credits.overview: A village faces a wave of terror when three women fall prey to demonic forces, becoming deadly instruments of malevolence and revenge.

credits.title: The Female Followers of the Devil
credits.overview: Three women in a small village conceal dark secrets, including unholy alliances and a mysterious ingredient used in a popular curry restaurant.

credits.title: Hidayah
credits.overview: Bahri, a young man who lives in Mekarsari Village. One day, Bahri realized that something was wrong in Mekarsari Village. Out of curiosity, he also found out what was really going on in the village where he lived.

credits.title: #FriendButMarried 2
credits.overview: As Ayu and Ditto finally transition from best friends to newlyweds, a quick pregnancy creates uncertainty for the future of their young marriage.

credits.title: Hanya Manusia
credits.overview: Annisa must divide the time between her family and her duty to investigate cases of kidnapping of minors. The pressure she experienced reached a maximum point when her only younger sister was kidnapped.

credits.title: Matt & Mou
credits.overview: A seemingly platonic friendship gets tested when a high school teen wants her closest friend to endorse her new romance with a local musician.

credits.title: Illogically Sane
credits.overview: Four friends work on film production in the method that has never been done before. But when they all have different goals, how could the film be made? Gila Jiwa crosses diverse genres of horror, action, drama, comedy, and musical.

credits.title: Iseng
credits.overview: Inspired by a true story about a young rookie detective paired with an experienced officer, a flirtatious secretary, a prostitute, three thugs, a driver, a restaurant owner, a cook, and a business man, all related in one deadly connection rooted in greed, lust, and deceit.
